role_declaration: Design engineer and brand consultant. SVA-trained, thirteen years enterprise architecture, original AI methodology.

manifesto.short: Design eye from SVA. Systems thinking from thirteen years and 1,100 deployments on an enterprise platform. AI methodology I built myself. One practice, three ways it shows up: consulting, teaching, and making.

routes.name: The Work
routes.definition: Professional and personal. Same eye on all of it.
routes.description: Thirteen years holding structural coherence on an enterprise platform. A jewelry brand. Print, music, a novel. Different materials, same way of seeing.

routes.name: The Research
routes.description: Accommodation Design, Input Inversion, Prosthetic Cognition, Semantic Flattening, Lens Extraction, Voice Governance. The methodology formalized and peer-accessible.

routes.name: The Writing
routes.description: A spiral curriculum tracing the same practice across construction sites, classrooms, enterprise platforms, kitchens, DJ booths, and AI systems. The book in progress.

routes.name: The School
routes.definition: Joinery. For creative practitioners working with AI.
routes.description: Task decomposition, input inversion, voice governance. Three weeks on your own real project. The methodology taught, not just documented.

routes.name: The Consulting
routes.description: Your product is real but your platform doesn't show it. I find the gaps across identity, photography, architecture, and copy. Diagnostic, rebuild, or course.
